headline: Imminent Strait of Hormuz Blockade Threatens to Cripple Global Semiconductor Supply Chain.
summary: The escalating US-Iran conflict raises the immediate specter of a Strait of Hormuz blockade, which would severely disrupt global oil and gas shipments, causing massive energy spikes and directly paralyzing Taiwan's critical semiconductor industry. This development poses an unprecedented geopolitical and supply chain crisis, impacting AI infrastructure, semiconductor fabs, and critical material transport globally.
